```artifact
@startuml
actor Patient
participant "Prescription System" as PS
participant Chemist
participant Lab
participant Admin

== TC-001: Prescription Received by Patient, Chemist, and Lab ==
Patient -> PS: Submit Prescription
PS -> Patient: Prescription Received
PS -> Chemist: Prescription Received
PS -> Lab: Prescription Received

== TC-002: Chemist Provides Medicines via Offline Delivery ==
Patient -> PS: Submit Prescription
PS -> Chemist: Prescription Received
Chemist -> Chemist: Prepare Medicines
Chemist -> Patient: Medicines Delivered

== TC-003: Lab Collects Specimen and Delivers Lab Report ==
Patient -> PS: Submit Prescription
PS -> Lab: Prescription Received
Lab -> Lab: Collect Specimen
Lab -> Lab: Generate Lab Report
Lab -> Patient: Lab Report Delivered
Lab -> PS: Update Lab Report

== TC-004: Chemist and Lab Receive Limited Information ==
Patient -> PS: Submit Prescription
PS -> Chemist: Prescription Received (Limited Info)
PS -> Lab: Prescription Received (Limited Info)

== TC-005: Admin Populates Speciality Database ==
Admin -> PS: Populate Speciality Database
PS -> PS: Speciality Database Updated

== TC-006: Admin Links Specialities to Doctors ==
Admin -> PS: Link Specialities to Doctors
PS -> PS: Doctor Database Updated

== TC-007: Admin Populates Labs and Chemists Databases ==
Lab -> PS: Send Lab Data
Chemist -> PS: Send Chemist Data
PS -> PS: Labs and Chemists Databases Updated

== TC-008: Patient Registers into the System ==
Patient -> PS: Register
PS -> PS: Patient Registered

== TC-009: Prescription Not Found Error ==
Patient -> PS: Submit Prescription
PS -> Chemist: Prescription Received
Chemist -> Chemist: Prepare Medicines
Chemist -> Patient: Medicines Not Available

== TC-010: Specimen Collection Failed Error ==
Patient -> PS: Submit Prescription
PS -> Lab: Prescription Received
Lab -> Lab: Collect Specimen
Lab -> Patient: Specimen Collection Failed

== TC-011: Lab Report Not Generated Error ==
Patient -> PS: Submit Prescription
PS -> Lab: Prescription Received
Lab -> Lab: Collect Specimen
Lab -> Lab: Generate Lab Report
Lab -> Patient: Lab Report Not Generated

== TC-012: Network Latency Boundary Test ==
Patient -> PS: Submit Prescription
activate PS
activate Chemist
activate Lab
activate Patient
... Network Latency ...
PS -> Chemist: Prescription Received
Chemist -> Chemist: Prepare Medicines
Chemist -> Patient: Medicines Delivered
PS -> Lab: Prescription Received
Lab -> Lab: Collect Specimen
Lab -> Lab: Generate Lab Report
Lab -> Patient: Lab Report Delivered
deactivate Patient
deactivate Lab
deactivate Chemist
deactivate PS
@enduml
```
